notes: Printer Bot 3.1.0 prints the Catbox and ImgBB links viewers copy from those sites, as 3.0.11 did for Imgur. A Catbox album (catbox.moe/c/<id>) and an ImgBB album (ibb.co/album/<id>) print their first picture only, never the rest; on ImgBB that is the picture the album shows first. An ImgBB viewer link (ibb.co/<id>) prints its picture, and a Catbox thumbnail prints the full file. Printer Bot asks the site which picture it is before the receipt prints (at most 3 seconds a message); a link with no picture prints [image]. As before, only in a High Roller message, with the site switched on and Allow images on. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.1.0 on GitHub.
